spans.text: One mockup per page, with its accompanying design note.
full-width LIVE hero card with embedded identity strip, pulsing LIVE NOW badge, big exam title, DM Mono 44px countdown timer, and an extra-large forest-green "Enter Examination Hall
Student Dashboard — Empty state (no live exam)
This is the default state — 95% of loads. Reassuring card with a shield icon, friendly title, calming subtitle, and a subtle "View My Results" escape hatch.

Full student chrome. Three sections stacked: Live Now (red dot) / Upcoming (slate dot) / Completed (slate dot, muted rows). Live card has a prominent bordered treatment with countdown + Enter button. Upcoming rows have
date badges + "Not live yet" hint. Completed rows have green "Completed" chips + View Results link.
Blue book-open icon + "No exams right now" + copy explaining what EXAMS are for newer students. Offline banner shown at the top as an example of the warning banner.
Same shell as Exams, but the Tests nav item is active and the empty state icon is purple zap + different copy explaining what TESTS (Flash Anzan) are.
lands here. Read-only card with status pill, title, meta, 3 info cells (duration/questions/level), and a blue "Not yet available" notice explaining that the exam will open when the teacher starts it.

Calm pre-assessment screen. Sidebar is hidden entirely. Breathing circle animation, 76px DM Mono countdown, exam title, Optimal network pill, consent acknowledgment, and an extra-large "I'm Ready" CTA button. Exit
button in the top-left corner for escape.

Vertical table only. Operator and number now sit ~18px apart instead of ~48px.op-colnarrowed to 40px withtext-align:right,num-colpadding-left dropped to 10px. Divider reduced to 1px slate so the two columns read as one tight
Same tight-gap table, longer 10-row sequence. Font scales to 22px and row padding compresses to 10px vertical so all 10 rows + result row fit cleanly. Four negative rows (56,142,213,45) in crimson.
STUDENT › FLASH ANZAN TEST — INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE
Screen 1 — List page · happy path (mixed published + pending)

Hero card showing the latest published result on top. Below it, filter chips (single-select), then one unified Academic Ledger with both published and pending rows. Pending rows show an amber "Pending" pill in the Grade
Screen 2 — List page · empty state (no submissions)
Student has never submitted an exam. Hero and ledger both replaced with a centred card that sends them to the Exams page.
Screen 3 — List page · filter empty state
Student has results but the active filter (here: "Pending") returns zero matches. Hero and chips stay visible; ledger is replaced with a compact "Clear filter" reset.
Screen 4 — Detail page · EXAM published, answer key unlocked
Full happy path. Back link, header band (type/duration/date), big score panel with green rail, unlocked Answer Sheet CTA card.
Screen 5 — Detail page · published but answer key locked
Score + grade visible, but admin hasn't released the answer key yet. The CTA card is in its locked state — non-interactive, no hover, no arrow.
Score panel mirrors the EXAM detail layout — Score + Grade.
Submission exists but admin hasn't published results. Amber rail, Clock icon, no score rendered. Answer sheet card is implicitly locked (pending implies not graded).
Screen 8 — Answer Sheet · EXAM happy path (mixed correct / wrong / unanswered)

Vertical scroll of question cards. EXAM questions render the v5 EquationTable. Tiles have four states: correct-and-picked (green + Check), correct-only (green), wrong-pick (crimson + X), neutral. Caption adapts. Time footer
Screen 9 — Answer Sheet · TEST one-line reconstruction
TEST questions store onlyflash_sequence(no written equation). Rendered as a single centred line with crimson negatives. Caption below explains the student saw these one at a time during the flash.
Student pasted the URL directly but admin hasn't released the answer key (or the submission is still pending). Centred lock card replaces the whole body.
Screen 11a — Admin Release card · unreleased state
Lives on the admin per-assessment detail page, directly above the answer-key view. Neutral grey rail when unreleased.
Screen 11b — Admin Release card · released state
Green rail, CheckCircle icon, timestamp + actor from activity_logs, student unlock count explaining the gate logic interaction.

Base UI dialog. Primary warning explains the gate logic: only students with published results see the answer sheet. Secondary warning only appears when zero published submissions exist for this paper.
Amber confirm button for the destructive-ish action. Copy notes that un-releasing does not retrieve what students already saw.

Single read-only profile card with a minimal hero (avatar + name + role line). School Info section visible by default. More Info section collapses/expands as one block. NULL fields render asNot mentioned. Avatar falls back to
initials when avatar_url is null. No editable fields, no save flows. Standard student shell with Profile active in the sidebar (Help & Support nav entry removed).
This entry is an overview note for the frames that follow — no standalone visual for this card.
Hero strip + School Info section visible. More Info collapsed to a single toggle row showing the chevron pointing down. This is the landing state.
Frame 2 — /student/profile · More Info expanded (all fields filled)
Same card with the toggle in expanded state. Personal info (DOB, gender) and guardian contacts visible. Consent shows the green verified pill. Chevron flipped 180°.
Frame 3 — /student/profile · Null-heavy state (More Info expanded with mostly empty fields)

Same card with the More Info section showing severalNot mentionedfallbacks. This is what a student record looks like when only the minimum required fields (full_name + level + cohort) were entered at admin-create time.
Demonstrates the fallback styling: italic + lighter colour for unfilled fields. The verified pill is absent because consent is unverified — the row shows "Not verified" instead.

Command Center layout. KPIs at top (3 cards). Main content: Active Live Assessments on the left (2/3 width), Activity Feed on the right (1/3 width). Page header has a dynamic subtitle showing live student count in real time.
Main list page. 4-column table: Roll No. | Name | Level | Actions (View + delete).
Empty State 1 — No students at all
Full app shell with sidebar + top bar. Welcome card with two action buttons.
Filter bar still visible with active filters. "Clear filters" link as the action.
land here. Profile hero + 5 sections stacked. Click "Edit Profile" at top to flip Personal + Academic sections into edit mode.

After clicking "Edit Profile". Edit banner appears at top. Personal Info + Academic Info fields become editable inputs. Recent Sessions + Danger Zone stay read-only (they have no editable fields anyway).

Slides in from the right when admin clicks "View Student List" on the detail page. Backdrop dims the detail page underneath. Shows (1) drawer header with total stats, (2) a search bar to filter students, (3) "Gave the Exam"
table with S.No, Roll, Name, Score, and "See Answer Sheet" button per row, (4) "Missed the Exam" table below with just S.No, Roll, Name.
Opens when admin clicks "+ Add Student" on the list page. 4 fields: Full Name, Roll Number, Level, Date of Birth. Dialog over a darkened backdrop.
Opens when admin clicks "Import CSV". Dashed upload zone + template download callout. After upload, an error report appears in place of the upload zone (not shown in this mock).

Sortable level cards with drag handle + sequence badge + name + stats row (students count, assessments count) + View button + overflow menu. Summary strip at top shows totals. Tip pill reminds admin they can drag to
Landing view for /admin/levels/[id]. Hero card with seq badge + stats. Tab strip below (Students active). Tab content: "+ Add Student to Level" CTA + search + 3-column table.
After clicking the Assessments tab. Same hero card. Same tab strip (Assessments now active). Tab content: "+ Create Assessment for Level" CTA + search + 3-column card grid pre-filtered to this level.
Opens when admin clicks "+ Add Level" on /admin/levels. Just one text input for the level name. New level auto-appends to the end of the list; admin can drag to reorder afterward.
Main list page. EXAM/TEST segmented toggle
vertical stack of full-width row cards with context-aware action buttons.
Empty State 1 — No assessments at all
First-time institution. Full chrome, no filter bar (nothing to filter), welcome card with primary CTA.
Filter bar still visible with active filters highlighted. Amber icon. "Clear all filters" link.
Full-page wizard, sidebar hidden. Horizontal stepper at top (Step 1 active). Two big cards side by side for EXAM vs TEST. EXAM is selected (green border + tint + check badge).
Stepper shows Step 1 completed, Step 2 active. 4 form sections + Save as Default toggle at the bottom. All 12 fields visible.
Stepper shows Steps 1 & 2 completed, Step 3 active. Split pane: question list on the left (40%), editor on the right (60%). Question 2 is selected.
Step 3b — MCQ Builder (TEST variant with Flash Config)
Same split pane as 3a, but above it there's a purple Flash Config card with params + Preview Flash button. Same pipe-format questions, same editor.
Triggered by "Preview Flash" button on Step 3b. Modal over dimmed backdrop showing a sample flash at the configured speed. Progress bar at top, counter at bottom, playback controls below.
Stepper shows 1–3 completed, Step 4 active. Bento grid of review cards — each section has an "Edit" button that jumps back to that step. Publish Now / Save as Draft action row at the bottom.
All 5 steps completed. Large green check icon. "Assessment Published" title. Summary chips. 4 action buttons including red "Start Session Now" as the contextual 4th.
Same shell, blue file icon, "Draft Saved" title, 3 action buttons (no Start Session Now since there's nothing to start yet).

Card grid of currently LIVE exams. Each card: red left accent, status + type + level badges, title, red urgent time-remaining strip, 4 mini-stats (active count + submitted + progress + started), red Monitor button.

Click into one exam. Hero card with 4px red accent + title + meta + BIG red countdown + Force Close button + 4 KPI mini-cards (In Progress / Submitted / Disconnected / Waiting). Below: search + realtime pill + 4-column
student table with live status badges and progress bars.
Red-topped destructive dialog. Warning icon, scary copy, impact box showing real counts, and a type-to-confirm input. Force Close button is disabled until admin types "CLOSE" exactly.
Same page, different state after force-close or timer expiry. Gray CLOSED badge, timer replaced with "Ended at" label, Force Close button replaced with "View in Results
". Below the hero: a Session Summary card with 4
final stats. Student table is frozen (no realtime pill, no animations). Action row at bottom with Export + View Results.
Results Hub — v4 (logout restored + design polish)

Changes: (1) Logout button added to the bottom of the sidebar with a user card above it. (2) Design polish: cards now have a hover-reveal left accent bar in forest green, subtle lift on hover, refined typography with tighter
letter-spacing on headings, vertical dividers between stats, status pill active state uses solid dark green, left-accent bar on active nav item, more sophisticated shadows.
Result Detail — v3 (font bumped +2px across the board)
Every text element is 2px larger. Base body is 16px (was 14), H1 is 28px, H3 is 19px, KPI values are 34px, KPI labels are 13px, nav items are 16px, table cells are 15–16px, buttons are 15–16px.

Full page at /admin/results/[paperId]/students/[studentId]. Shows the student's profile card with aggregate score on the right, three mini KPIs (Correct / Wrong / Accuracy), then the answer sheet table — one row per question
with all 4 options visible, student's pick highlighted, correct answer shown in a pill, wrong rows tinted light red.
Centered single-column layout (no right sidebar). Three sections stacked: Institution Info (with logo uploader + 6 fields)
Grade Boundaries (segmented EXAM/TEST toggle + editable rows)
Sticky save bar at the bottom shown in the "unsaved changes" state.
